notes: «وبهذا الإسناد» takes the whole chain of prev1 (report 17, which writes its chain): all its names are inherited, in order; no back_reference is written
Left out of the inherited names: «بنيسابور» (a place) and «ويقال له: الهروي والنهرواني والشيباني» (an aside, not a name)
The saying «قال رسول الله» is the Prophet's words relayed through the inherited chain; the Prophet is not a link
